summary: Patriot National Bancorp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a $5.5 million registered direct offering of 5,739,130 common shares to accredited investors at $1.15 per share, versus a $0.94 Nasdaq close on September 23, 2026. The deal includes 4,782,608 voting shares plus warrants for Non-Voting Common Stock exercisable six months after issuance at $1.25 per share, one warrant per five shares purchased. The offering is conducted without a placement agent or underwriting discounts, with closing expected on or about September 24, 2026. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation.
